Le santal y est discret, fondu dans la vanille. Il demande un nez patient. Plus vert et plus mélancolique que Coco.
why.chanel-n-5: Le santal n'y est pas la vedette, mais il porte tout le bouquet d'aldéhydes et de fleurs. Ernest Beaux l'a associé au vétiver et à la vanille, et c'est lui qu'on sent en fin de journée, crémeux sur la peau. Le côté savonneux peut dérouter. Plus abstrait que Paris, plus sage qu'Obsession.
why.yves-saint-laurent-paris: Une brassée de roses poudrées de violette, sur un fond de santal, de musc et d'ambre. Sophia Grojsman a fait de la rose la vedette, et le santal la prolonge sans bruit. C'est le choix des amatrices de fleurs qui veulent un fond chaud. Son opulence peut paraître datée. Plus floral que Dolce Vita.
why.carolina-herrera-good-girl: Amande, café et tubéreuse, puis cacao, tonka et santal en fond. Louise Turner a joué le bien et le mal, et le santal adoucit le cacao. C'est le choix le plus actuel de la sélection. On le trouvera peut-être trop sucré. Plus gourmand que Coco, moins trouble qu'Hypnotic Poison.

faq.q: Quel parfum femme sent le santal ?
faq.a: Dolce Vita de Dior est celui où le santal se sent le plus clairement, crémeux sous une pêche et une cannelle. Obsession le place au cœur, ce qui est rare. Pour un santal plus sec et boisé, Santal 33 de Le Labo est un mixte qui se porte très bien sur une femme.

faq.q: Parfum santal femme : pour quelle saison ?
faq.a: Surtout l'automne et l'hiver, quand sa chaleur crémeuse se déploie. Coco, Obsession et Hypnotic Poison sont faits pour le froid. Dolce Vita et Paris se portent aussi au printemps. Pour un santal portable aux beaux jours, préférez un floral plutôt qu'un oriental.

faq.q: Le santal est-il une note masculine ?
faq.a: Non, il est très présent dans les parfums féminins. Côté femme, il sert de fond crémeux aux fleurs et à la vanille. Côté homme, on le marie plutôt au cèdre, au vétiver ou au cuir, ce qui le rend plus sec. Santal 33 montre bien la version mixte.

en.title: Best sandalwood perfumes for women: 9 creamy picks
en.meta: Dolce Vita, Coco and Santal 33: our ranking of sandalwood perfumes for women, from milky woods under flowers to dry sandalwood.
en.intro: If you want a women's perfume where sandalwood comes through, start with Dior Dolce Vita. Peach, cinnamon and a creamy sandalwood that smells like a warm tart. Chanel Coco is next, with sandalwood under clove and tonka. Hypnotic Poison takes third for anyone who likes sandalwood melted into vanilla and coconut. Santal 33, a unisex pick, is here for those who prefer their sandalwood dry.

sections.title: In women's perfume, sandalwood is the skin under the flowers
sections.body: In feminine perfume, sandalwood is rarely the subject. It is the skin. Set under rose, jasmine or tuberose, it rounds out the flowers and gives them a warm, milky base that lasts for hours. That is its job in N°5, Paris and Hypnotic Poison. It usually comes with vanilla, tonka or musk, which all push its creamy side. Men's fragrances pair sandalwood with cedar, vetiver or leather and keep it drier. Santal 33 sits in between. It is unisex, it pairs sandalwood with leather and papyrus, and it wears very well on women. If you love sandalwood for its own sake, look for perfumes that lift it into the heart, like Obsession.

sections.title: Oriental or floral sandalwood: choosing well
sections.body: Two families split this list. The orientals set sandalwood on amber, vanilla or incense. Coco, Obsession, Hypnotic Poison and Vol de Nuit belong here. They are warm, made for fall and winter, and several score 4 or 5 for intensity. One or two sprays are enough, ideally on skin rather than clothes. Florals like N°5, Paris and Dolce Vita keep sandalwood in the base, under powdery flowers or peach. They are easier by day and in spring. Good Girl bridges the two, with sandalwood backing cacao and tonka. Our tip: judge a sandalwood perfume an hour after you put it on. Top notes often mask the wood, which only shows once the perfume settles.

why.dior-dolce-vita: Our top pick because the sandalwood is creamy and easy to read, backed by sunny peach and a hint of cinnamon. Rose and lily in the heart stay light. Wear it on fall or spring days. Its very 1990s look will not suit minimalists. Brighter than Coco and less sugary than Hypnotic Poison.
why.chanel-coco: Jacques Polge set sandalwood under a heart of rose, jasmine and clove, with tonka and amber. The result is a baroque oriental, rich and flawless. Sandalwood gives it the final roundness. An evening and winter scent. Spicier than Dolce Vita and more polished than Obsession.
why.dior-hypnotic-poison: Annick Ménardo melted sandalwood into vanilla and coconut, with very ripe plum and apricot. The most gourmand take on the list, hazy and addictive. Too dense for summer. The sandalwood reads like warm skin under the sugar. Darker than Dolce Vita.
why.calvin-klein-obsession: One of the few women's perfumes that lifts sandalwood into the heart, alongside jasmine and orange blossom. Amber, musk and incense carry it on. Jean Guichard composed the 1980s amber at full volume. Strong and a bit dated. Less sweet than Hypnotic Poison and more direct than Coco.
why.le-labo-santal-33: Unisex, and the driest sandalwood here. Cardamom, violet and iris up top. Then ambroxan, sandalwood and papyrus over cedar and leather. Nothing like the milky wood of classic feminines. Great if you find most sandalwoods too soft. Its ubiquity has dulled its edge.
why.guerlain-vol-de-nuit: Bitter galbanum up top, iris and violet in the heart, then vanilla, sandalwood and benzoin. Jacques Guerlain made a powdery, nocturnal perfume full of nuance. The sandalwood is quiet, folded into the vanilla. It rewards a patient nose. Greener and more wistful than Coco.
why.chanel-n-5: Sandalwood is not the star, but it holds up the whole aldehydic bouquet. Ernest Beaux paired it with vetiver and vanilla, and it is what you smell at the end of the day, creamy on skin. The soapy side can be off-putting. More abstract than Paris and tamer than Obsession.
why.yves-saint-laurent-paris: An armful of roses dusted with violet, over sandalwood, musk and amber. Sophia Grojsman made rose the star, and sandalwood carries it quietly. A good pick for flower lovers who want a warm base. Its opulence can feel dated. More floral than Dolce Vita.
why.carolina-herrera-good-girl: Almond, coffee and tuberose, then cacao, tonka and sandalwood at the base. Louise Turner played good against bad, and the sandalwood softens the cacao. The most current pick on the list. Some will find it too sweet. More gourmand than Coco, less hazy than Hypnotic Poison.

faq.q: Which women's perfume smells like sandalwood?
faq.a: Dior Dolce Vita is the clearest, with creamy sandalwood under peach and cinnamon. Obsession puts sandalwood in the heart, which is rare. For a drier, woodier sandalwood, Le Labo Santal 33 is a unisex scent that wears beautifully on women.

faq.q: What season suits sandalwood perfume?
faq.a: Mostly fall and winter, when its creamy warmth opens up. Coco, Obsession and Hypnotic Poison are built for the cold. Dolce Vita and Paris also work in spring. For sandalwood in warm weather, pick a floral over an oriental.

faq.q: Is sandalwood a masculine note?
faq.a: No, it is everywhere in women's perfume. There it serves as a creamy base for flowers and vanilla. Men's fragrances tend to pair it with cedar, vetiver or leather, which makes it drier. Santal 33 shows the unisex version well.
